spans.s:
mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Produced in Nepal.
f. (-ली)
1 Double jasmine.
2 Red arsenick.
3 Śephālikā, (Nyctanthes tristis.)
4 Indigo.
E.
नेपाल Nepal, अण् and ङीप् affs.; brought from thence.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Produced in or brought from Nepal, &c.
n. (-कं)
Copper.
E.
नेपाल, and ठक् aff.

n. (-णं)
Dexterity, cleverness, skill.
E.
निपुण skilful, aff. अण्; also with ष्यञ् aff., नैपुण्य n. (-ण्यं.)
